parameters.focusNode: Supplies a focus node owned and disposed by the caller.
parameters.autofocus: Requests focus when the control first appears.
parameters.first: The pane at the start, or the top.
parameters.second: The pane at the end, or the bottom.
parameters.axis: Side by side, or one over the other.
parameters.initialFraction: The first pane's share at the start.
parameters.minFirst: The minimum extent of the first pane.
parameters.minSecond: The minimum extent of the second pane.
parameters.onChanged: Told the first pane's share as it moves.
